facts.statement: The Free Realms team released a commemorative yearbook video recapping the features, games, pets and jobs introduced into the game over the past year.
facts.quote: commemorative yearbook video that relives all the great features, games, pets and jobs that have been introduced into the game in the past year

article_summaries.title: Free Realms - What is New?
article_summaries.summary: This short freerealms.com news post (captured 2010-05-25) announces a commemorative yearbook video from the Free Realms team. The video recaps the features, games, pets and jobs added to the game over the previous year. The text gives no specifics, so it is useful mainly as a dated marker that the game was about a year old by then.
